manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the blue pen on the box and insert it into the pen holder on the right.

Task description: The target is the blue pen crossed over other pens on the white box surface. The receiving container is the white square-opening pen holder to the right of the box, which already contains a black pen.

Success criteria: One end of the blue pen passes through the right-side holder opening, and the shaft is inserted and remains inside. Merely resting it on the rim or leaning it against the outside does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Grip a straight blue-pen section away from the crossing point with space on both sides, avoiding the clip and fine tip. Leave sufficient length at the insertion end to reduce picking up a neighboring pen or blocking the holder opening with the gripper.
- The opening can be slightly wider than the pen shaft, with the fingers closing across it. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides rather than pressing from above or rolling the pen away.
- When adjusting the pen orientation, first clear both ends from the box surface and neighboring pen, then turn it in an open area with the insertion end pointing down, avoiding contact from the long pen ends with nearby objects.
- Aim the insertion end into a gap inside the holder opening away from the existing black pen, keeping the gripper above the rim. If the pen end hits the rim or another pen, raise it slightly and correct rather than forcing it and risking a jam or tipping the holder.
- Release only after the pen is inside the holder and supported securely. During withdrawal, watch the clearance between the fingertips and pen clip to avoid pulling the pen back out.

narration: I will use the piper-control skill to run this authorized real-robot episode strictly with the given parameters, following the manual and live observations returned by the tool.

I confirmed the blue pen is on the white box, and the target is the square pen holder on the right, which already contains a black pen. I am adjusting the gripper orientation to approach the blue pen shaft away from the crossing point.

An orientation adjustment during approach reached a controller limit and the arm has stopped stably. I reduced the tilt using the returned actual pose and continue adjusting a reachable approach path within this episode.

The gripper is near the blue pen and is correcting the shaft position relative to the fingers in small steps. Before closing, I will confirm the shaft is between the pads, then check the grasp after lifting.
The blue pen is aligned between the fingers, and the neighboring black pen remains on the box surface. I am lowering the gripper gradually, checking grasp height before closing.

After the first close, a short test lift did not show the blue pen leaving the box surface. I reopened the gripper and am lowering the grasp point further based on the live view to avoid carrying it before it is securely held.

The blue pen has left the box surface with the gripper and the opening is stable; the other two pens remain in place. Next I will turn its tip downward in open space, then align with an area inside the holder away from the black pen.
The blue pen remains securely grasped and has been moved above the area near the pen holder. I am continuing to orient its tip and leave clearance from the black pen inside and the sign behind it.

The last pose adjustment reached a wrist singularity, and the controller stopped stably. Using the new actual state, I moved to a reachable pose while retaining the blue pen. Its tip is now nearly downward; I will descend in small steps to align with the holder mouth.

The blue pen is nearly vertical and descending gradually through the gap on the holder's left side. The holder and existing black pen remain stable in the image. Near the opening, I will reduce step size further and confirm the pen end has entered before release.

The pen tip has descended into the holder opening. The blue pen has not noticeably tilted, and the holder has not moved. I am completing the final small lowering step, then will release and withdraw to inspect how it rests.

After release, the blue pen fell into the pen holder and remained stable inside, leaning next to the existing black pen. I am withdrawing slightly and checking that it does not come out with the gripper.
